description: Search the Freudly catalogue of psychological self-assessment tests (personality, anxiety, depression, burnout, relationships, IQ and more). Filter by keywords, topic, language (en, es, ru), maximum duration in minutes and maximum number of questions. Returns test ids, short summaries, duration, number of questions, topics and the URL where each test is taken.

inputSchema.description: Параметры search_tests — общие для REST и MCP.

language.description: Language of the test and its page: en, es, or ru (ru has a small catalogue).

query.description: Keywords to match in test names and descriptions, written in the same language as `language` (e.g. "anxiety", "burnout", "ansiedad", "тревога"). Short keywords work better than sentences.
query.title: Query

topic.description: Topic or theme in the same language as `language` (e.g. "depression", "relationships", "personality"). Matched against the catalogue topics; falls back to keyword search.
topic.title: Topic

inputSchema.title: PublicTestSearchParams

name: search_tests
title: Search psychological tests
